text: You say this says five timeslots. B and C sent this counter that they have got at the MacLayer to five timeslots. Now the rule is that if a node at the MacLayer has got this counter sent to a positive value greater than zero, for that node at the MacLayer, the channel has to be considered as busy. Okay, so this is a MacLayer thing. Okay, it's not physical layer. It's MacLayer. It's a counter. If they reach here, the duration is five timeslots, they set their count to five timeslots, and then they will decrease this counter with time. At every timeslot, they decrease their count. So that then after one timeslot, you get four remaining, then one more, three remaining, one more two remaining, more one remaining, zero. Then you can consider that at the MacLayer, the channel is idle again. Okay, now the duration value that is reported in the packet header.
